questions.question: Which artist has generated the most sales revenue?
questions.agent_sql:
SELECT Artist.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM InvoiceLine
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
questions.noretry_sql:
SELECT Artist.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM InvoiceLine
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

args.query:
SELECT Artist.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM InvoiceLine
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
